packageRules.description: Move the Playwright container tag in visual.yml and @playwright/test in opscenter/kit/package.json together: Playwright refuses to start when the browser image and the library differ.

Hold @axe-core/playwright below 4.14. 4.14 turns on the label-content-name-mismatch rule (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name) in the gallery axe check, and it flags the rail, prominent and compact buttons, the account trigger, the build card, the list-controls direction button and every month grid day cell. The kit needs one deliberate label-in-name pass before the bump can merge; the pin is lifted in the change that does it.
